purpose: Balance pulse-out with pulse-in. Stop negative quorum sensing waste.

negative_qs.definition: When signal density drops below quorum threshold, organisms INCREASE housekeeping instead of decreasing it. More cleaning, more broadcasting, more resource waste. The opposite of what you'd expect.
negative_qs.printer_example: No print jobs → printer idles → more cleaning cycles → more ink waste. The ABSENCE of work causes MORE activity, not less.
negative_qs.system_example: We removed Galaxy, songbird, biomeos. Those produced signals. Now the remaining services hear less → pulse harder → waste more.
negative_qs.biological: Bacteria in low-density environment produce MORE autoinducer molecules per cell, trying to find quorum. The individual works harder when the colony is sparse.

immediate: Run arena-evolve periodically (feed models = give them work)
Accept inbound neutrino messages (subscribe, not just publish)
Give printer work: schedule multicultural celebration prints
structural: For every cron OUT pulse, wire an IN acknowledgment
swarmVine needs peers (golgi, graftGate) to gossip BACK
RustDesk relay enables inbound desktop connections
SSH key exchange with graftGate enables inbound commands
balance_plan.tope_formula: pulse_health = IN / (IN + OUT). Target: 0.4-0.6. Current: ~0.11 (critical imbalance)
